assays.assay_description: Standard mouse cage under red light in sound-insulated chamber; 1 min habituation, dorsal coat sprayed 3x with 10% sucrose, videotaped 5 min; grooming time scored by blinded researcher with stopwatch.

application_type.evidence: the mice were intraperitoneally injected (1 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: The mice were allowed to move freely for 1 min to habituate to the arena.

setup_restrain.evidence: The mice were allowed to move freely for 1 min to habituate to the arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the testing cage during the 5-min recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Behavioral testing was conducted on the days following the injection.

outcomes.summary: Grooming time after sucrose spray did not differ among SCVS female mice treated with vehicle, psilocybin, norbaeocystin or baeocystin (1 mg/kg).
outcomes.statistics: One-way ANOVA followed by Tukey's post hoc test; no significant differences.
outcomes.evidence: Meanwhile, no differences were observed among all groups of SCVS mice regarding grooming time in the splash test (Fig. 6f).

assays.assay_description: 60x40x20 cm box divided into three chambers by transparent walls, red light; 10 min exploration with empty enclosures, then 10 min with unfamiliar female in one enclosure and toy mouse in the other; interaction times, discrimination index and total exploration time scored by blinded researcher.

application_type.evidence: the mice were intraperitoneally injected (1 mg/kg)

setup_habituation.evidence: On the test day, the test mouse was first allowed to explore the box with two empty enclosures for 10 min.

setup_restrain.evidence: The test mouse was placed back in the box for 10 min and allowed for free exploration.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: our study showed that a single dose of psilocybin (1 mg/kg) increased social interaction among SCVS females 24 h after injection.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin and norbaeocystin (1 mg/kg) increased social interaction in SCVS female mice compared with vehicle; baeocystin had no reported effect.
outcomes.statistics: One-way ANOVA followed by Tukey's post hoc test; p < 0.05.
outcomes.evidence: the psilocybin- and norbaeocystin-injected SCVS mice showed a significant decrease in their immobility time in the forced swim test and an increased in social interaction time (Fig. 6b, c)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Differential index (DI) and total exploration time in the social interaction test (SIT).

B4_ethological.evidence: The interaction time between the test mouse and the social mouse was recorded as A

B5_social.evidence: the social mouse was placed in one of the enclosures, while a toy mouse was placed in the other enclosure.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate social preference; no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: videotaped and analyzed by a researcher blinded to the experimental groups

B8_multivariate.evidence: one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc test

E1_environment_type.evidence: a 60 × 40 × 20 cm box, divided into three chambers

E6_spatial.evidence: divided into three chambers by two transparent dividing walls

D4_baseline.evidence: Empty-enclosure phase occurred after drug administration; no pre-drug recording.

D5_followup.evidence: increased social interaction among SCVS females 24 h after injection

judge_notes: All three candidates identified the same six behavioural assays (ST, SIT, NSF, FST, SPT, OFT); c-FOS immunostaining excluded as histological endpoint.

D5_followup set to Yes for all assays (following qwen): paper states 'Behavioral testing was conducted on the days following the injection' and outcomes 'assessed one day following the drug injection' (>=24 h).

time_to_assay: SIT explicitly 24 h post-injection; other assays kept at modal early_2to24h/1440 with medium confidence because exact per-test day (testing spanned ~4 days per Discussion) is in the Fig. 6a timeline, not text.
B1 corrected to rubric counts: FST, NSF, ST, SPT = 1 measure (score 0); OFT and SIT = 2-3 measures (score 1); deepseek/gemma inconsistent score/value pairs overridden.
FST setup_restrain = yes per rubric (FST cylinder listed as restraint); gemma's 'no' overridden.
SIT B5 = Restricted (2) and E7 = barrier (1): stimulus mouse inside enclosure; gemma's 'Free' rejected. B4 = Yes (modal) as social investigation is directly scored.
SIT D4 baseline = No: empty-enclosure phase occurred post-drug, not pre-drug. SPT D4 = No: day-1 adaptation data not reported.
SPT D1 kept at modal 'Continuous monitoring' (24-h home-cage intake periods); E3 bedding set 0 (not reported) rather than deepseek's inferred Yes.
NSF E8 kept at modal 0: pellet is the test stimulus; deepseek's Yes noted.
